codegen_trace.notes: Single reactive controller; IR-driven obstacle event + endTask shutdown; advisory motor commands via Actuator.move.
Composition: Sensor, Actuator, Clock, clockResetTime state variable, single step() state machine.
Three modes; terminal mode named Stopped instead of Final (pipeline constraint: theory-generated controller must not contain a Final state).
MOVE_VEL=1.0, TURN_VEL=2.0, OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD=0.5, TURN_DURATION=2.0.
Sealed interface with signal records Obstacle, Tick, EndTask.
Two-payload Move(lv, av) output encoded as the multi-arg Actuator.move(lv, av) call (RoboChart events carry one payload; the ETL models multi-arg actuator calls as LOperations operation calls).
distance() returns latest IR reading; large default 100.0 m when no reading available.
Stores last commanded lv/av, exposed via lastLv()/lastAv().
Sole sensor measurement consumed by the controller.
Set from Clock.now() on the Moving->Turning transition; drives the timed Turning->Moving transition. Clock dependency: src/main/java/sranger/time/Clock.java.
Moving initial; entry action move(MOVE_VEL, 0) fired at power-up (constructor) and on Turning->Moving.
On entering Turning: move(0, TURN_VEL) and clockResetTime = now().
Terminal mode (named Stopped, see SR-DM1 note): entry action move(0, 0).
Named predicate obstacleDetected = sensor.distance() <= OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD, guard on Moving->Turning.
Named predicate turnDurationElapsed = timer.now() - clockResetTime >= TURN_DURATION, guard on Turning->Moving.
Field initialised to SRangerMode.Moving.
Moving->Turning on Obstacle event with obstacleDetected guard; clock reset + move(0, TURN_VEL).
Moving->Stopped on EndTask; move(0, 0).
Moving->Moving self-loop on Tick, no action.
Autonomous Turning->Moving when turnDurationElapsed; move(MOVE_VEL, 0).
Turning->Stopped on EndTask; move(0, 0).
Turning->Turning self-loop on Tick, no action.
Each mode block has at most one branch per trigger; one transition per behavioural requirement.
Monotonic time source (seconds) backing clockResetTime and the turnDurationElapsed predicate.
